recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-43101 wording at the active authoritative source location without editing generated-looking bundle.svg output; leave FHIR-43106 covered by its separate reconciliation commit.
issue_request: FHIR-43101 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by FHIR-I. It requested fixing the missing closing parenthesis in the Bundle.entry.fullUrl RESTful URL comment and clarifying that the resource type and id portions of a RESTful-looking fullUrl must match the entry resource type and id.
initial_application: Commit c3a11dc9db104fae1e5355ff962f186f09bf4fa2 applied the substantive type/id clarification to source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml and removed the old id-only wording, but left the visible parenthetical typo because the markdown link was still followed directly by a comma.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini and listed as infrastructure normative content, so source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml is current build source. The same 2025 application commit also touched adjacent FHIR-43106 wording; FHIR-43106 is already represented on the combined branch and was not re-decided here. The referenced Zulip thread and FHIR-I minutes support the Jira request without showing a later conflicting direction.
reconciliation: Changed the Bundle.entry.fullUrl comment from "meets the [regex](references.html#regex), then" to "meets the [regex](references.html#regex)), then", preserving the already-applied resource type/id matching sentence.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: added the missing visible closing parenthesis after the regex link in the Bundle.entry.fullUrl comment.
